name: Homi
description: Shared household calendar and chequebook for your family, with installable modules.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything Homi keeps: the PostgreSQL database, the installed modules and their backups, and state/ with the secrets made on first start and the first password. Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Homi web app and API, published on host as 6879. Plain http, for your https reverse proxy to point at: Homi only works fully through the proxy's https address.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace https://homi.example.com with the https address of your reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) that points at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6879. Homi needs https: on plain http the browser can't save changes or add events. Homi only accepts sign-ins from this exact address.

variables.name: HOMI_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with as the household's first administrator. Used once, on the first start.

variables.name: HOMI_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first administrator's password (8 to 128 characters). Leave it empty to have one made for you: it is shown in the app's logs (CREDENTIALS). Used once, on the first start.
